svg.text: Every answer comes from READ-ME-FIRST.txt, the raster's properties and the USGS gage page. Check them yourself.

svg.text: Lidar from 3DEP projects flown 2013–2023, read

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the service Oct 8, 2026. Rating 30.0 in

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: WHY

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Why were they created?

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3DEP: the national 'best available' elevation.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The gage: to measure the river's flow. The

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: FEMA study: flood insurance rate maps, the

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1%-annual-chance floodplain you compare with.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: HOW

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: How were they collected and processed?

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Airborne lidar, bare earth, HYDRO-FLATTENED:

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the river is a flat water surface on the day

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: it was flown. We resampled 2 m to 5 m. All 90

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: gage peaks carry code 6: affected by

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: regulation or diversion upstream.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: WHO

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Who maintains them, and may you use them?

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: USGS (3DEP, NWIS gage and rating), FEMA

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (flood study and map), UGRC (NHD river line,

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: building footprints). Public data; credit

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: each source on your maps and in your report.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: HAND is measured from the DEM's river cells — the water surface on the day of the flight, not the channel bed —

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: while h is measured from the gage's zero-flow level. Say in your report what that mismatch does to your floods.
